resources.string:
Data Collection: Shadow does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data. We believe your usage habits are your own business.

Local Processing: All app usage tracking is performed locally on your device using Android\'s standard UsageStats APIs. This data never leaves your device and is not shared with any third parties.

Permissions: Shadow requires Usage Access to calculate friction delays and enforce intentionality. This permission is used solely for the core functionality of the app.

Security: Because we do not use servers or cloud storage, your data is as secure as your physical device.
